children: Entergy settled its 2025 underwritten forward sale agreements by delivering 11,145,984 shares for approximately $913 million.
Physically settled outstanding 2025 forward sale agreements on Sept 2, 2026 by delivering 11,145,984 shares.

After settlement, no obligations remain under the 2025 Underwritten Forward Sale Agreements.
The company still has separate forward sale agreements from May 5, 2026 tied to a $2.175B registered offering of 19,247,788 shares.
